tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-50, surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta labels, captions and timestamps on surface-50 and surface-100. 5.5:1 on surface-50.

tokens.name: surface-50
tokens.usage: Page background — the warm paper ground.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Card, nav rail and panel backgrounds, set against surface-50.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Hover fill for list rows and nav items; resting fill for locked/private surfaces.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers, card outlines, the rule under a WeekHeader. Not for UI boundaries that carry meaning.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input outlines and any UI boundary that carries state (selected, invalid). 3.7:1 on surface-50 and surface-100.

tokens.name: accent-neuro
tokens.usage: Primary interactive color: links, the active nav item, primary buttons, quiz progress fill. 8.4:1 on surface-50, 9:1 with on-fill.

tokens.name: accent-neuro-soft
tokens.usage: Background tint for the active nav item and a selected (not yet graded) quiz answer.

tokens.name: accent-warm
tokens.usage: The public/portfolio accent — the Public badge, homework tags, GitHub/live-link icons. Never used for private or locked content. 7.2:1 on surface-50.

tokens.name: accent-warm-soft
tokens.usage: Background tint for Public badges and homework portfolio cards.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Correct quiz answers, completed states. Deliberately blue-shifted (teal, not pure green) so it reads apart from danger for color-blind viewers. 5.9:1 on surface-50.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Incorrect quiz answers, destructive actions. Always paired with an icon or word, never color alone. 4.7:1 on surface-50.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on filled accent-neuro, accent-warm, success and danger surfaces.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element. ≥3:1 on surface-50, surface-100 and surface-200.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The cover name and the site's own landing hero — used once per page at most.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles: Sources, Quizzes, Notes & Insights, Homework.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles inside a page, e.g. a WeekHeader.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles: a source title, a quiz title, a homework title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Paragraph copy, quiz question text, note bodies.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary copy inside a card: a quiz answer option, a note excerpt.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase-tracked nav items and eyebrows. Apply text-transform: uppercase in markup.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, source counts, byline meta — set in ink-soft.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Week chips (WK 03), quiz score numerals, the AccessBadge label.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, file names, repo paths on a HomeworkCard.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip and tag padding, gap between a badge and its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between list rows (SourceItem, nav items); compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard card padding; gap between a card's internal blocks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between components in a list; card-grid gap on narrow layouts.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding; gap between a WeekHeader and its sources.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space between major page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding of a page, space above the first WeekHeader.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, primary/secondary buttons, quiz answer options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, the sign-in dialog, the nav rail's outer edge.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, the AccessBadge, the week tag.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting elevation for cards and the quiz option list.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The sign-in panel, open dropdowns, anything floating above the page.
